an10.26:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare pavatte pabbate.
an10.26:1.2: athakho kālī upāsikā kuraragharikā yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kālī upāsikā kuraragharikā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca
an10.26:3.1: imassa nu kho bhante bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
an10.26:4.1: paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ
an10.26:4.2: yāvatā kho bhagini paṭhavīkasiṇasamāpattiparamatā tadabhiññāsi bhagavā
an10.26:4.3: tadabhiññāya bhagavā ādimaddasa ādīnavamaddasa nissaraṇamaddasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa
an10.26:4.4: tassa ādidassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti
an10.26:5.9: viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamā kho bhagini eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthābhinibbattesuṃ
an10.26:5.10: yāvatā kho bhagini viññāṇakasiṇasamāpattiparamatā tadabhiññāsi bhagavā
an10.26:5.11: tadabhiññāya bhagavā ādimaddasa ādīnavamaddasa nissaraṇamaddasa maggāmaggañāṇadassanamaddasa
an10.26:5.12: tassa ādidassanahetu ādīnavadassanahetu nissaraṇadassanahetu maggāmaggañāṇadassanahetu atthassa patti hadayassa santi viditā hoti
an10.26:5.13: iti kho bhagini yantaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā kumārīpañhesu
an10.26:7.1: imassa kho bhagini bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
